title: App Studio 改版（follow-up of 3-3）：界面文案句子里的「Studio」统一改为「应用搭建 / App Studio」
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: os-dev report 7196663169 on #37566 (PR #37581), open question 1. #37566 renamed the brand, the app label and the doors into Studio only. Sub-issue of #37424.
Grade: area:ux · Chore · p3 · evidence: in each UI pack about 30 prose strings still say "Studio", for example "unpublished changes in Studio", `common.editInStudio`, `console.studio.accessRequired`, the Studio-namespace refusal sentences, `console.ai.viewBuiltAppInStudio` and `empty.openInStudio`.
Reader: area `ux-37424` or the next holder of area:ux.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：中文界面里句子中提到的「Studio」也改成「应用搭建」，英文改成「App Studio」。改完后，标志、入口和句子里的叫法一致。
- 为什么：#37566 只改了标志、应用名和入口，句子里还是「Studio」，中文界面会两个名字混着出现。
- 需要你做的：无。只改显示文字，地址、权限名和技能文档都不动。

## What

- Rename every prose mention of Studio in the UI packs: en and zh first, then the other packs as the en-drift gate requires. Keep each sentence's structure and change only the name.
- Update the inline `defaultValue` literals that `check-i18n-call-site-keys` pairs with the en values, and any pin test that reads those strings (residue, call-site, untranslated-identity).
- Out of scope: identifiers, the `/studio` address, `studio.access`, package names, and `skills/**`.

## Acceptance

- `grep` over the UI packs finds no user-facing "Studio" that does not belong to "App Studio" (or the zh 应用搭建 form), apart from identifiers. Pins are updated, not weakened.
- Wait until PR #37581 merges before starting.
